pass_means: On U: partial^mu C_mu c=0 and mixed partials of C; four product-rule terms in partial^mu S cancel; V(CC+CC)=-S => partial^mu T=0 and partial^rho T=0 on U. Not pushed through z=0. Mutations detect nonzero remainders.

div_C_on_smooth.domain: smooth locus Q != 0 (then extend by continuity/WF to U)

mixed_partials_C.identity: partial_alpha C_beta gamma = partial_beta C_alpha gamma
mixed_partials_C.reason: C_ab = -partial_a partial_b D_F; mixed partials of D commute on Q!=0

analytic.step1: partial^mu (C_mu c C_nu d) = (partial^mu C_mu c) C_nu d + C_mu c partial^mu C_nu d
analytic.step2: partial^mu C_mu c = 0 on U => first summand drops
analytic.step3: partial^mu C_nu d = partial_nu C^mu_d  (mixed partials + raise)
analytic.step4: C_mu c partial_nu C^mu_d + C_mu d partial_nu C^mu_c - C_a d partial_nu C^a_c - C^a_c partial_nu C_a d = 0 by renaming a<->mu and C-symmetry
analytic.conclusion: partial^mu S_mu nu; cd = 0 on U

smooth_finite_difference_crosscheck.method: central finite difference of generated T at z=(0,1,0,0)
smooth_finite_difference_crosscheck.note: Cross-check of analytic cancellation; primary proof is algebraic

first_pair.proof: T=(-S)V; partial^mu S=0 on U; V constant

second_pair.proof: Exchange symmetry T_{mu nu rho sigma}=T_{rho sigma mu nu}, or repeat the S-argument on the second V factor

both_pairs.extension_Ward_separate: Off-diagonal vanishing is NOT the Ward identity of the extended kernel (X-A cor:noether / Gate 4 contact layer)
